prompt: A single realistic open modern laptop computer for a lawyer's desk. Neutral dark graphite metal casing, horizontal keyboard base, laptop lid opened exactly 90 degrees so the screen is upright and vertical. A large perfectly flat rectangular display with width to height ratio 900:560, thin straight black bezel. Screen is uniformly blank matte black, no image, no interface, no writing, no reflection graphic. Clean rectangular keyboard base with individual low relief black keys without symbols, a centered trackpad, simple hinge. Clear separation between lid, screen and keyboard base. Complete standalone laptop only, no cables, no desk, no hands, no room, no accessories, no logo, no text. Refined realistic PBR materials.
